description: This file defines the Cart model class for the checkout process in OpenCart. It includes methods to retrieve products in the cart and calculate totals, interacting with other parts of the system such as uploads, taxes, and extensions.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Model class for cart operations in checkout, such as retrieving products and calculating totals.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products in the cart, including images, options, subscription details, and prices with taxes applied.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Calculates and sorts the total amounts, taxes, and order total, using configured extension modules.
